spanish: Como pecado, como culpa, una ley a ellos; el sacerdote que expiará en él, a él será.
grammarChanges: Translated תּוֹרָה (fail finding, h03007007003) with the Spanish common noun 'ley' instead of leaving it as untranslated 'torá'.
Reordered 'torá una' to 'una ley' to follow standard Spanish numeral-before-noun order.

Removed the definite articles from 'como el pecado' / 'como la culpa' (warn finding, h03007007001-002): no article is present on these two nouns in the morphology, unlike the article on the priest; changed to 'como pecado' / 'como culpa'.
readerNote: Removed the articles on pecado/culpa to match the bare Hebrew nouns (no article), so they read as general terms rather than specific, already-introduced offerings.
